scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @traceframe/playground
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @traceframe/core && npm run build -w @traceframe/react && npm run build -w @traceframe/python
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @traceframe/playground
scripts.check: npm run check -w @traceframe/core && npm run check -w @traceframe/react && npm run check -w @traceframe/python && npm run check -w @traceframe/playground
scripts.pack:check: npm run build:packages && npm pack --dry-run -w @traceframe/core && npm pack --dry-run -w @traceframe/react && npm pack --dry-run -w @traceframe/python
